instructions: US state sales-tax rates and economic-nexus thresholds (plan WP C2).
This file ships EMPTY on purpose: the platform does not invent rates.
Every row must be filled by the owner (or the accounting service) from the
state's own published rate schedule / nexus statute, with the exact source
URL and the date the figure was read. A row is a factual claim about a
state's tax law and is only as good as its source and retrieval date.
Row fields:
state               ISO 3166-2:US two-letter code (e.g. "CA").
rateBps             state sales-tax rate in BASIS POINTS (7.25% = 725).
State-level rate only: county/city/district add-ons
are NOT modelled — say so in `notes` if the state
has them.
nexusThresholdCents economic-nexus threshold in USD CENTS
nexusWindow         "calendar" (the evaluation window is the calendar
year) or "trailing_12m" (the trailing twelve
months). Match the state's statute.
sourceUrl           https:// URL of the state's page for the figure.
retrieved           YYYY-MM-DD the figure was read from that page.
notes               optional, free text (e.g. what is not modelled).
A state is only ever taxed when BOTH hold: the owner has registered the
state (admin surface, a legal act) AND the row above is present and not
older than US_TAX_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 120). Otherwise the invoice is
refused, never computed from a guessed or stale rate.
Validate after editing: `billing-service --check-us-tax-data-only` (or BILLING_CHECK_US_TAX_DATA_ONLY=true); it prints every row with its age and exits non-zero on any validation error.
